row.evidence: Mediafly's developer docs say you can "provision and manage your Mediafly user identities across systems with ... SCIM" (SCIM 2.0 at scim.mediafly.com/{companycode}/scim/v2), while mediafly.com/pricing redirects to a contact-sales page with no public plans.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans; www.mediafly.com/pricing redirects to /contact. SCIM 2.0 is documented on devdocs.mediafly.com (Users and Groups: POST, GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE; filter subset, startIndex/count paging; bearer token and company code issued by Mediafly on request). Deactivate via active=false; DELETE hard-deletes. User create/PUT does not set group memberships; Groups do. A KB article links an Azure SCIM user/group provisioning guide (behind a Mediafly share consent page, not read). Neither Okta OIN (404) nor the Entra gallery tutorials list Mediafly; SSO is a custom SAML app, with optional SAML JIT user creation and JIT group assignment. The legacy Accounts API (accounts.mediafly.com/api/3.0) also creates, deactivates, deletes users and manages roles.

plans.name: Mediafly (quote-only)
plans.notes: No public tier table; SSO from the trust page, SCIM and Accounts API from devdocs, none tied to a plan.

auth.token_source: Access token and company code issued by Mediafly on request

operations.notes: Group membership is managed on Groups (POST with members, PATCH add/remove/set, PUT replace); user POST/PUT does not change memberships. X-HTTP-Method-Override supported for clients limited to GET/POST.

deprovision.notes: PATCH active=false deactivates; DELETE hard-deletes and is discouraged.

filtering.notes: Subset of SCIM filter expressions; sortBy/sortOrder supported.

custom.how: Mediafly can be configured to support additional attributes per customer

limitations.text: Creating or replacing a user does not set group memberships; use the Groups endpoints.
Only a subset of SCIM filter expressions is supported.

auth.notes: POST /authentication/authenticate with an account's username/password returns a bearer access token valid up to an hour; productId issued by Mediafly.

capabilities.notes: Roles are the Accounts API's user grouping; invite = create with emailUser=true or the registration/approval flow.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/mediafly/ returns 404. Mediafly documents Okta SSO as a custom SAML 2.0 app ('Create New App'); no Okta SCIM guide.

entra.notes: Not in the Entra saas-apps toc.json; Mediafly's Azure AD SSO guide uses a non-gallery application, and a KB article links an Azure SCIM user/group provisioning guide, recorded as via_generic in row.idp.

fallbacks.other_sync: Global User Management across Mediafly solutions; legacy Accounts API
